affectedPaths: docs/云端迁移常见错误清单.md

connectivity.producer: Client WindowObservationRunner captures one exact-HWND immutable prepared frame for the active demandId and generation, and records successful HTTP delivery separately from demand lifetime.
connectivity.transport: ObservationRequest.preparedFrames carries the payload once; ObservationResponse.preparedFrameDemands keeps business demand identity without requiring payload retransmission after successful delivery.
connectivity.consumer: CloudWholeTaskObserver consumes the exact accepted frame from CloudWindowObservationInbox and FiveRingTaskV3 consumes only an exact actionId whose operation belongs to the current requested Dialog operation set.
connectivity.ordering: exact demand -> capture once -> successful HTTP delivery -> Client marks generation delivered -> Cloud retains accepted frame while slot is occupied -> exact operation publish -> validated actionId consume -> action ACK/cancel retires frame and demand; replacement/cancel fences every older generation.

proves: Client production producer and transport delivery state are reachable in the observation send path.
Successful delivery, transport retry, cancel, and replacement are reviewed on one exact demand identity.
Cloud receives and retains the exact accepted frame independently from prepared-slot availability.
Slot occupancy cannot demand a second upload of the same immutable payload.
Prepared publication cannot overwrite an action that won the slot during frame analysis.
Exact action consumption remains observable by actionId until the retained frame lifecycle claims its one-shot receipt.
Dialog waiting and consumption are bound to the requested operation and exact actionId.
A tracker action cannot masquerade as a give-item or inspect Dialog result.
A give-item-map terminal reaches HANDLE_DIALOG before transfer/route memory settlement or pathing clear.
The retained exact terminal permits leaving HANDLE_DIALOG only after transfer, route and exact intent clear all succeed.
The left-top status probe captures only the exact 16x29 bound-window ROI.
Diagnostic evidence backlog is bounded and cannot block or alter business capture results.
